info.name: Flashyre - Candidate API
info.description: Happy and negative API checks for the candidate page. Run with Newman: npm run api:full:local / api:smoke:dev / api:smoke:prod. Everything created is tagged and removed in the last folder.

exec: // ---- shared helpers (copied into each request that needs them) ----

pm.test("200 with paging fields", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("results"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("count"); });
// ---- shared helpers (copied into each request that needs them) ----

pm.test("200 and same email", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().email.toLowerCase()).to.eql(("qa-" + pm.collectionVariables.get("runId") + "-main@flashyre-qa.example")); });
pm.test("cleanup ok and nothing left for this run", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
// ---- shared helpers (copied into each request that needs them) ----
// ---- shared helpers (copied into each request that needs them) ----
// ---- shared helpers (copied into each request that needs them) ----

pm.test("both candidates listed", () => { const ids = pm.response.json().map(c => c.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("h1"))); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("h2"))); });
pm.test("200 and not empty", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const j = pm.response.json(); const rows = Array.isArray(j) ? j : j.results; pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.above(0);
const cat = rows[0].category; const same = rows.filter(r => r.category === cat);
